text:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding sample app misattributed traffic after a key rotation. Short repro below.

anya: repro: set RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, start app, rotate project key in console -> subsequent calls used REDWOOD_API_KEY (org) instead of project key.

leo: I hit this too. Looks like the SDK loader now prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY when present. Logs: `auth: using REDWOOD_API_KEY (org)` even though RW_API_KEY_PROJECT exists.

brynn: Minimal repro: ```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY='org-zzzz'
export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT='proj-1111'
node examples/onboard.js
# request header = org-zzzz
```

anya: Also noticed streaming clients (SSE/WS) don't attempt to refresh on 401 after rotation — they just close. That breaks our live preview in the sample app.

leo: Proposed changes:
- Explicit env precedence: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, RW_API_KEY_SERVICE, RW_API_KEY_ORG, then REDWOOD_API_KEY.
- Emit a one-time warning if REDWOOD_API_KEY and any RW_API_KEY_* are both set.
- Add startup diagnostic line: `selected_api_key=RW_API_KEY_PROJECT (proj-1111 - ****1111)`
- For streams: on 401 try tokenProvider.refresh() once, retry, else emit `auth:rotation_failed` event to app.

brynn: +1. We should gate token refresh behind RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true so infra teams can opt out. Also add RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true for a migration window.

ci-bot: created issue #1532: "sdk: env key precedence + stream refresh behavior"

docs-bot: added docs stub for env var precedence at https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/auth#env-precedence

anya: Action items: brynn open PR to change loader + add diag; leo add e2e that rotates key and asserts stream continuity; I will update onboarding docs to recommend unsetting REDWOOD_API_KEY when using project-scoped keys.

leo: I'll also add a tiny CLI check that warns on `rw start` if conflicting envs are set.

anya: Thanks — want the warning shipped ASAP so new customers don't silently mis-bill. Closing thread unless someone hits another regression. :v:
